description: You can use the Cost Optimization Hub API to programmatically identify, filter, aggregate, and quantify savings for your cost optimization recommendations across multiple Amazon Web Services Regions and Amazon Web Services accounts in your organization. The Cost Optimization Hub API provides the following endpoint:    https://cost-optimization-hub.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
name: cost-optimization-hub

subcommands.description: Updates the enrollment (opt in and opt out) status of an account to the Cost Optimization Hub service. If the account is a management account or delegated administrator of an organization, this action can also be used to enroll member accounts of the organization. You must have the appropriate permissions to opt in to Cost Optimization Hub and to view its recommendations. When you opt in, Cost Optimization Hub automatically creates a service-linked role in your account to access its data
subcommands.name: update-enrollment-status

options.description: Sets the account status
options.name: --status

options.description: Indicates whether to enroll member accounts of the organization if the account is the management account or delegated administrator
options.name: --include-member-accounts
